notes: Deploy only Stacker for imd/acc on Ethereum mainnet. Constructor arguments are the real IMD token followed by the real StakedIMD (sIMD) vault. Both addresses are immutable. Stacker has no owner, admin, fee, pause or upgrade. Its constructor stores the addresses without external calls; the first non-zero credit checks sIMD.asset() == IMD and approves the vault once. A failed credit rolls back validation, approval and transfers. credit(trader, imdAmount) pulls IMD from the calling project and calls sIMD.deposit(imdAmount, trader), minting shares directly to the trader. Per-project IMD and share totals and the grand IMD total are stored on chain; per-trader figures and points are computed from Stacked(project, trader, imd, shares) events. ProjectRegistry, oracle contracts and test doubles are outside this deployment. Projects approve Stacker once and fund their chosen 0.25%-1% cashback rate from existing fees, with the fee portion leaving the project for liquidity, burns or prizes at least as large as cashback. Integrations check gasleft() before the call, wrap credit in try/catch and pay plain IMD to the trader on failure. Resolve the real trader from router hookData, otherwise sender, never tx.origin. These integration rules are project responsibilities; Stacker does not enforce trade rates or fee splits.
